license_required.quote: Any person, except as specifically exempted in this subdivision, who practices or offers to practice soil science or wetland science in this state shall be subject to the provisions of this subdivision.

issuing_authority.value: Office of Professional Licensure and Certification
issuing_authority.quote: who has been duly certified by the office.

name.quote: A board of natural scientists is established to administer the provisions of this subdivision.

type.quote: The board shall consist of 7 persons appointed by the governor and council, 2 of whom shall be soil scientists, 2 of whom shall be wetland scientists who are not also soil scientists, and 3 of whom shall be public members.

umbrella_agency.value: Office of Professional Licensure and Certification
umbrella_agency.quote: who has been duly certified by the office.

moral_character_required.quote: To be eligible for certification as a soil scientist, a person shall be of high ethical professional standards

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate or associate degree from an accredited college curriculum, with required semester hours in soil science
degree_required.quote: Be a graduate of an accredited 4-year college curriculum leading to a baccalaureate degree, where the applicant successfully completed 30 semester hours in biological, physical and earth science, including 15 semester hours in soil science

accrediting_body.quote: Be a graduate of an accredited 4-year college curriculum leading to a baccalaureate degree

degree_level.quote: Be a graduate of an accredited college curriculum leading to a baccalaureate or an associate degree, where the applicant has successfully completed 15 semester hours in soil science, and have a specific record of an additional 4 or more years experience in the practice of soil science.

school_approval_basis.quote: Be a graduate of an accredited 4-year college curriculum leading to a baccalaureate degree

credential_pegged.quote: have successfully passed an examination designed to determine the person's proficiency and qualifications

tiers.license_class: Certified Soil Scientist – Tier A (baccalaureate, 30 credit hours including 15 in soil science)
tiers.quote: Be a graduate of an accredited 4-year college curriculum leading to a baccalaureate degree, where the applicant successfully completed 30 semester hours in biological, physical and earth science, including 15 semester hours in soil science, and have a specific record of an additional 3 or more years experience in the practice of soil science.

tiers.license_class: Certified Soil Scientist – Tier B (baccalaureate or associate, 15 credit hours in soil science)
tiers.quote: Be a graduate of an accredited college curriculum leading to a baccalaureate or an associate degree, where the applicant has successfully completed 15 semester hours in soil science, and have a specific record of an additional 4 or more years experience in the practice of soil science.

tiers.license_class: Certified Soil Scientist – Tier C (baccalaureate or associate, or equivalent credits, 6+ years experience)
tiers.quote: Be a graduate of an accredited college curriculum leading to a baccalaureate or associate degree, or have earned the equivalent number of credits, and have a specific record of an additional 6 or more years in the practice of soil science.

required.quote: have a specific record of an additional 3 or more years experience in the practice of soil science.

experience_source.quote: have a specific record of an additional 3 or more years experience in the practice of soil science.

duration.value: 3 to 6 years depending on education tier
duration.quote: have a specific record of an additional 3 or more years experience in the practice of soil science.

kind.quote: Experience in the practice of soil science shall be of a grade and character that indicates to the board that the applicant is competent to practice as a soil scientist.

exams.name: Soil Scientist Certification Examination
exams.notes: Examination designed to determine the person's proficiency and qualifications, including references to soil characteristics in the New England region.
exams.quote: have successfully passed an examination designed to determine the person's proficiency and qualifications, including references to soil characteristics in the New England region, to be engaged in the practice of soil science

available.quote: All boards or commissions shall grant a license to an individual certified or licensed in another state if it determines that the requirements or standards for certification or licensure in that state are equivalent to, or greater than, those established in New Hampshire.

requirements.value: Reciprocal licensure available where the other state's requirements are equivalent to or greater than New Hampshire's. Board posts list of qualifying states on its website.
requirements.quote: All boards or commissions shall grant a license to an individual certified or licensed in another state if it determines that the requirements or standards for certification or licensure in that state are equivalent to, or greater than, those established in New Hampshire.

exists.quote: A board of natural scientists is established to administer the provisions of this subdivision.

regulatory_model.quote: Any person, except as specifically exempted in this subdivision, who practices or offers to practice soil science or wetland science in this state shall be subject to the provisions of this subdivision.

credential_type.quote: shall, upon payment of a fee, be issued a certificate attesting that the applicant is a certified soil scientist

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who practices or offers to practice soil science or wetland science in this state for others without a certificate in accordance with this subdivision ... shall be guilty of a class B misdemeanor

title_protection.quote: any person who falsely impersonates any other certified soil scientist or certified wetland scientist

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices or offers to practice soil science or wetland science in this state for others without a certificate in accordance with this subdivision ... shall be guilty of a class B misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a certificate to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a certificate to practice under this subdivision.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any offense involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or any offense involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any unprofessional or dishonorable conduct unworthy of and affecting the practice of soil science or wetland science.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any unprofessional conduct, or dishonorable conduct unworthy of, and affecting the practice of soil science or wetland science.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfitness or incompetency by reason of negligence or willful misconduct in the performance of professional duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unfitness or incompetency by reason of negligence or willful misconduct by a certified soil scientist or certified wetland scientist in the performance of professional duties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction to alcohol or other habit-forming drugs to a degree rendering the person unfit to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Addiction to the use of alcohol or other habit-forming drugs to a degree which renders the person unfit to practice under this subdivision.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violation of the provisions of the subdivision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or repeated violation of the provisions of this subdivision.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of a certificate in another jurisdiction that was not reinstated.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of a certificate, similar to one issued under this subdivision, in another jurisdiction which was not reinstated.

definition_quote.value: Practice of soil science means any professional service that requires the application of pedological principles to identify, classify, and prepare maps delineating soils according to the standards of the National Cooperative Soil Survey or other standards approved by the board.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of soil science" means any professional service that requires the application of pedological principles to identify, classify, and prepare maps delineating soils according to the standards of the National Cooperative Soil Survey or other standards approved by the board.

methods_authorized.quote: is qualified to identify, classify, and prepare soil maps according to the standards of the National Cooperative Soil Survey, or standards adopted by the New Hampshire department of environmental services, or standards adopted by the board

tiered_registration_levels.quote: Any person who has successfully passed the examination or has otherwise qualified as a certified soil scientist, apprentice soil scientist, certified wetland scientist, or apprentice wetland scientist, shall, upon payment of a fee, be issued a certificate

minimum_soil_science_credit_hours.quote: the applicant successfully completed 30 semester hours in biological, physical and earth science, including 15 semester hours in soil science

supporting_science_credit_hours.quote: the applicant successfully completed 30 semester hours in biological, physical and earth science, including 15 semester hours in soil science

teaching_or_research_counts_as_experienc.quote: Teaching soil science courses or performing research in soil science at an accredited college, university, or institution offering an approved soil science or agronomy curriculum shall be considered as experience in the practice of soil science.

advanced_degree_experience_credit.quote: Each advanced degree in a related field shall be counted as one year of experience.

supervised_experience_required.quote: Actual field mapping experience in an acceptable apprenticeship program shall count as experience time and shall account for a minimum of one year of the experience requirement.

subordinate_definition_included.quote: The work of an employee or a subordinate of a person holding a certificate under this subdivision, or any employee of a person practicing lawfully under paragraph I, done under the direct supervision of a person holding a certificate under this subdivision

firm_corporation_practice_allowed.quote: Nothing in this subdivision shall prohibit one or more soil scientists from practicing soil science through a business organization. In any such entity engaged in the practice of soil science at least one partner, officer, or employee shall be a certified soil scientist

firm_certificate_of_authorization_requir.quote: Nothing in this subdivision shall prohibit one or more soil scientists from practicing soil science through a business organization.

nonresident_practice_exempt_days.quote: when such practice does not exceed, in the aggregate, more than 30 working days in any calendar year

wetland_delineation_scope_included.quote: "Certified wetland scientist" means a person who, by reason of his or her special knowledge of hydric soils, hydrophytic vegetation, and wetland hydrology acquired by course work and experience ... is qualified to delineate wetland boundaries and to prepare wetland maps

national_cooperative_soil_survey_standar.quote: is qualified to identify, classify, and prepare soil maps according to the standards of the National Cooperative Soil Survey

hydric_soil_and_redoximorphic_features_i.quote: a person who, by reason of his or her special knowledge of hydric soils, hydrophytic vegetation, and wetland hydrology

seal_or_stamp_required_on_documents.quote: Plans and reports prepared by a certified individual shall be stamped with the seal and signed by the certified individual during the life of the certificate.

code_of_ethics_required.quote: Ethical and professional standards required to be met by each holder of a certificate under this subdivision and how disciplinary actions by the board shall be implemented for violations of these standards.

reexamination_minimum_score_waiting_peri.quote: A candidate failing the examination 3 consecutive times shall be required to furnish to the office of professional licensure and certification evidence of additional experience, study, or education credits established by the board before being allowed to proceed with the examination.
